slides.title: EU gives €550,000 for families who fled Moyale
slides.body: Announced Nov 18 for those who crossed into Kenya

slides.text: The EU's humanitarian arm, **DG ECHO**, announced **€550,000** in emergency aid on **Nov 18**, Agence Europe reports.
The money goes through **UNHCR Kenya and the Kenya Red Cross** for **food, water, shelter and healthcare**.
Local authorities say up to **50,000** civilians have crossed into **Kenya** since **Oct 22**, Agence Europe reports.
**Protect civilians, open aid access.** Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Agence Europe (DG ECHO), Nov 18, 2026; Nation Africa
